content_sections.heading: About SMKC Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage)
content_sections.text: Sangli Miraj and Kupwad City Municipal Corporation is the municipal corporation for the cities of Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad. Its General Administration Department – Staff Recruitment/Promotion Cell has issued this notice for engaging the services of retired government and semi-government officers on contract basis for specific work. The notice says the posts belong to various departments of the Municipal Corporation; the post listed is Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is to be submitted in the name of the Hon. Assistant Commissioner at this address: Hon. Assistant Commissioner, G.A.D.-Staff Recruitment/Promotion Cell, Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad Municipal Corporation, Near Apta Police Chowki, Chaukoni Panyachi Taki (square water tank), First Floor, Sangli Write the application and attach your own recent photograph. Attach attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below. Write your current residential address and mobile number correctly in the application. Submit the application at the above office by 25 November 2026, during office hours. The notice does not prescribe an application form or a postal mode such as speed post; it states only that the application is to be submitted at the above office by the last date. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage), 1 vacancy, to be filled on contract basis for one year. The eligibility conditions printed in the notice are: The candidate must be a retired government or semi-government officer. Special qualification required for the specific work, or a minimum of three years' experience in the related work. The retired officer must be physically, mentally and health-wise fit, and must have the capacity needed for the proposed service. No departmental inquiry action should be pending or proposed against the retired officer, and the officer should not have received any punishment in such an inquiry. The notice does not name a particular degree; the requirement is the special qualification needed for the specific work or three years' experience in the related work. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of the post. The notice calls this an honorarium (monthly). No fixed amount is printed; the remuneration depends on each officer's own basic pension and dearness allowance.

rows.pay: Monthly remuneration equal to the basic pension received at the time of appointment (without considering commutation value) along with the dearness allowance on it

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Recent photograph of the candidate Attested copy of educational qualification Attested copy of experience Attested copy of Aadhaar card identity proof Attested copy of date of birth certificate The notice ends this list with "etc.", so other relevant documents may also be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The applications received will be scrutinised, and the final selection of eligible candidates will be made after an interview. The dates for this will be communicated separately. The selected candidate will be appointed for a period of 1 year.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMKC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage) in Sangli Miraj and Kupwad City Municipal Corporation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SMKC Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage) post?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted at the Sangli office by 25 November 2026, during office hours. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for this SMKC post?
faq.answer: Only retired government or semi-government officers can apply, provided no departmental inquiry is pending or proposed against them and they have not been punished in such an inquiry.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for SMKC Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage)?
faq.answer: The candidate needs the special qualification required for the specific work, or a minimum of three years' experience in the related work, and must be physically, mentally and health-wise fit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of SMKC Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage)?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is equal to the basic pension received at the time of appointment (without considering commutation value) plus the dearness allowance on it.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for SMKC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application with a recent photograph and attested documents, in the name of the Hon. Assistant Commissioner, G.A.D.-Staff Recruitment/Promotion Cell, at the office near Apta Police Chowki, Chaukoni Panyachi Taki, First Floor, Sangli, by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Applications will be scrutinised and the final selection of eligible candidates will be made after an interview, whose dates will be communicated separately.

faq.question: Q8. Is the SMKC Special Executive Officer (Water Drainage) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary on contract basis for 1 year, and gives no right to regular service or absorption into any government cadre.

faq.question: Q9. Is a bond required for this SMKC contract post?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must execute a bond on stamp paper in the prescribed format as per the Municipal Corporation's terms and conditions.
